data.name: Ward
data.gender_notes: Ward is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'weard,' meaning to keep, guard or protect. This name was commonly given to those who served as guards, protectors or wardens. The name Ward carries the meaning “Guardian, protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ward usually hope their child will grow to embody guardian, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual name, symbolizing protection and care for others.
data.etymology: Ward belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian, protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ward total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_latin.name: Ward

in_english.name: Ward
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ward is derived from Old English and Germanic terms, meaning 'protector,' 'guardian,' or 'watchman.' It carries a rich history in Christian tradition, symbolizing a person who safeguards and watches over others. The etymology of Ward can be linked to Hebrew and Greek concepts of protection and guardianship, reflecting a spiritual significance of care and vigilance. Historically, the name Ward has been used across various Christian cultures, representing a person of responsibility and trust.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ward" carries a strong sense of duty and protection, reflecting the important roles that guardians and protectors played in society during medieval times. This name was often given to children who were expected to uphold these values and make significant contributions to their community by assuming roles as protectors and law enforcers.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ward" evokes a sense of guardianship and protection by the Divine. It symbolizes the belief that God not only watches over and protects us but also calls us to take on roles as spiritual protectors and guides for others. Whether in our personal relationships or as part of a larger community, this name serves as a reminder of the sacred responsibility we have to care for and uplift others in their times of need. The power and courage inherent in the name "Ward" can inspire us to be strong in our faith, stand up for what we believe in, and always be there for those who rely on us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Ward may symbolize protection and guardianship. As a Christian name, it could represent one's role as a spiritual fortress, shielding others from harm and upholding the teachings of faith. Additionally, it may signify the idea of being watched over by God, with the belief that His divine presence serves as a constant source of strength and guidance.
